hallway.name: Dean's Office Hallway
hallway.description: A formal hallway outside the Dean's office. The secretary sits at her desk, guarding the entrance.
hallway.image_prompt: university hallway, secretary desk, formal atmosphere, fantasy style

deans-office.name: Dean's Office
deans-office.description: The imposing office of the Dean. Access requires a special key obtainable only from the secretary.
deans-office.image_prompt: grand university dean office, wooden furniture, academic portraits, fantasy style

stamped-form.name: Stamped Submission Form
stamped-form.description: An official form stamped by the department. The secretary demands it before handing over the office key.
stamped-form.image_prompt: official stamped document, red wax seal, fantasy university style

office-key.name: Dean's Office Key
office-key.description: A bronze key that unlocks the Dean's office door.
office-key.image_prompt: bronze key, official, university crest engraved, fantasy art

hero.name: Alden the Student
hero.description: A determined student fighting through bureaucracy to submit his project.
hero.image_prompt: young university student, backpack, frustrated look, fantasy setting

secretary.name: Secretary Halina
secretary.description: A strict and uncompromising secretary who follows the rulebook to the letter.
secretary.image_prompt: stern middle-aged secretary, glasses, university office, fantasy style

dialogues.before_talk: Halina: I cannot let you through without the official stamped form. Rules are rules.
dialogues.after_talk: Halina: Form first, then the key. No exceptions.
dialogues.after_satisfied: Halina: Very well. Here is the key to the Dean's office. Don't lose it.
dialogues.hostile: Halina: Security! This student is trespassing!

professor.name: Professor Riddle
professor.description: The professor is waiting inside the Dean's office to evaluate the student's project.
professor.image_prompt: elderly professor waiting, academic office, stern look, fantasy style

dialogues.before_talk: Riddle: You finally made it past Halina. Impressive. Now — let's see your work.
dialogues.after_talk: Riddle: Come back when you have something to show me.
dialogues.after_satisfied: Riddle: Acceptable. I suppose you may pass.
